name: Immersive Pitstops
author: Sedz
description: Makes career pit stops less predictable: stationary times spread from about 1.6 to 3 s, crew mistakes happen more often, and now and then a stuck rear right wheel nut holds the car in the box while the crew fight it. My Team and Driver Career, for you and the AI teams.

options.label: Stuck wheel nut
options.description: On: the crew mistake on the rear right wheel going on becomes a stuck wheel nut, with the crew fighting the wheel while the car waits on its jacks. It's one of the eight wheel mistakes, so about one mistake in eight. Off: the game's own short mistake.

options.label: Stuck wheel nut time
options.description: About how much longer a stop with a stuck wheel nut takes. The game plays the whole stop faster or slower with the crew's rolled speed, so the real time varies a little around it.

options.label: Hold the car until the crew finish
options.description: The pit lane lets a car go after about 20 s in its box even if the crew are still working. On: that limit is kept off while the crew work, so a stuck wheel nut lasts its full time and ends with the car dropped and released. Applies at once.

options.label: Longest hold (s)
options.description: A safety stop: after this long in the box the game's own limit is let back in, in case a crew never finishes.

options.label: Retirement chance (%)
options.description: How often a stuck wheel nut ends the car's race: the team gives up and the car is retired in its box. Otherwise the crew get the wheel on and the car goes back out. Yours and the AI's. 0 turns retirements off.

options.label: Give up after (s in the box)
options.description: How long the crew fight a stuck wheel nut before the team retires the car. If the stuck wheel nut is shorter, the car is retired as soon as the crew finish.

options.label: Log pit stops (testing)
options.description: Writes each stop's box time and the pit lane's limit to the launcher log.

options.label: Widen team pit times too
options.description: Also widens each team's own pit time range in the pit lane table. That table is read outside the careers too, so Grand Prix and other modes change as well. Off by default.

options.label: Test mode
options.description: For testing only: forces every pit stop, yours and the AI's. Fast: 1.6 s, no mistakes. Slow: 3.0 s, no mistakes. Stuck wheel nut: a mistake on every stop, and every wheel mistake plays the stuck wheel nut (with the time above). Set it back to Off to race.
